preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and 1 <= len(stdin) <= 10**5 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: stdin is a non-empty string of lowercase English letters with length up to 10^5

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each non-empty line of stdout contains exactly two space-separated values: the length of the answer and the answer itself (or its truncated form)
The number of output lines equals the length of the input string

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[0]) == len(stdin) - i for i in range(len(stdin)))
postconditions.description: The first value in each line is the length of the corresponding suffix (len(stdin) - i for the i-th line)

postconditions.expression: all((lambda s: s if len(s) <= 10 else s[:5] + '...' + s[-2:])(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[1]) == get_lex_smallest_suffix(stdin[i:]) for i in range(len(stdin)))
postconditions.description: The second value in each line is the lexicographically smallest string obtainable by removing adjacent duplicate pairs from the corresponding suffix, formatted as specified
